subject: SIG initiation: Meditrust — clarifying questionnaire scope & evidence owners
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@meditrust.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo follow-up + SIG initiation (Meditrust)

Hi Samir — thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Meditrust is primarily concerned with data residency (US-only), SOC 2 status, and HIPAA handling for PHI flows. You flagged an internal security review and a legal procurement window in July.
- As discussed, we recommend starting with the SIG Core/Cloud prefilling so your team can see coverage areas quickly, then escalate to CAIQ if your cloud auditor requires it.

Action items I can take now:
1) Share a prefilled SIG Excel with our recommended answers and primary evidence links. (See attachment: meditrust-sig-prefill.xlsx)
2) Loop in Redwood security (Kimberly) to confirm SOC 2 scope and where we store audit logs.
3) Capture evidence owners on your side so we can map docs (SOC 2, encryption certs, DPA).

Can you confirm: 1) who on your side will own evidence collection (security@meditrust.com or a named person), and 2) whether you need the prefills to show US-only hosting explicitly? Once you confirm, we’ll populate the sheet and send back within 48 hours.

Thanks — Jonas
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(attachment: meditrust-sig-prefill.xlsx - spreadsheet)
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@meditrust.com>

Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up + SIG initiation (Meditrust)

Jonas — appreciate the recap. Quick answers: 

- Evidence owner: please route evidence asks to security@meditrust.com and cc Alicia Torres (our procurement lead). Alicia will coordinate collection.
- Residency: yes, we need explicit US-only hosting answers and a diagram of data flow for PHI in the prefills.
- SOC 2: we will need the most recent SOC 2 Type II report and a high-level summary of scope (which services included). Can you provide a one-page SOC 2 summary for initial review?

Also: are there any encryption-in-transit certs or KMS docs you can attach now? That will speed our internal pre-review.

Samir

Head of IT Security, Meditrust

Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up + SIG initiation (Meditrust)

Hi Samir — thanks for the quick reply. Short answers and what we’ll attach: 

- SOC 2: I will send a SOC 2 summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) that outlines scope (control categories, AWS hosting region controls, and whether backup/DR are in scope). Full SOC 2 reports are shared under NDA; we can provision a read-only link or a signed copy once procurement executes the DPA.
- Residency & data flow: Jonas and Priyom will add an explicit US-only hosting answer in the prefills and attach a basic PHI dataflow diagram.
- Encryption/KMS: we use AWS KMS with customer metadata separation and TLS 1.2+ in transit; I’ll attach the KMS overview and cert references in the next message.

Next steps from us: complete the SIG prefill with US residency notes, mark Redwood evidence we can share immediately, and list items requiring NDA/DPA. Expect the completed prefills + evidence map by EOD Friday (June 12).

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Security Program Manager, Redwood Inference

Thanks all — quick confirmation and one clarifying ask from the implementation side.

Confirming timeline: we’ll deliver the prefilled SIG + evidence map by EOD today (June 12). Deliverables will include:
- Prefilled SIG Excel (answers marked: final vs. needs-DPA)
- Evidence map linking to our internal docs and the SOC 2 summary
- Short PHI dataflow sketch for your architecture review

Clarifying question: for CAIQ vs SIG — do you want us to fill SIG Core+Cloud only, or would you prefer we prefill CAIQ as well? CAIQ takes more time but helps cloud auditors. If procurement needs a CAIQ copy, tell us now and we’ll prioritize it for Monday.

Action: Samir/Alicia — please confirm evidence contact (security@meditrust.com is OK) and whether you want CAIQ included in the initial pass.
